name: neon-teamspace
description: Connect Claude Code to your Neon Teamspace instance and work the cards assigned to you: claim one, do the work in your repository, write the results into the card and move it on to review.

server_url.title: Neon Teamspace address
server_url.description: The address you open Neon Teamspace at, such as https://neon.example.com, with no slash at the end. The plugin connects to its /mcp.
